summary_brief: At TED2023, TikTok CEO Shou Chew discussed the platform's interest-based algorithm, content moderation policies, and addressed U.S. national security concerns over data and China by detailing 'Project Texas'.

actions.task: Continue rollout and third-party oversight of Project Texas for U.S. data localization and access controls.
actions.description_plain: Further implement and transparently communicate TikTok's data security and localization initiative (Project Texas) to regulators and users.

actions.task: Maintain and expand teen safety measures (default limits, restricted features, content filters) and safety prompts; continue "Stop, Think, Decide Before You Act" and search-redirect safety flows.
actions.description_plain: Operate and improve teen safety systems, including default screen-time limits, restricted features, content filters and in-app safety education flows.

actions.task: Promote Family Pairing guidance and screen-time education resources in-app and via partners (e.g., Digital Wellness Lab).
actions.description_plain: Collaborate with external partners and parents to promote Family Pairing and healthy screen-time education resources.
